<h2>Combine Selected sjSDM Fold Artifacts</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Combines, deterministically orders, and validates complete out-of-fold
coverage across selected-candidate fold results.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>combine_sjsdm_selected_fold_artifacts(
  list_fold_results = NULL,
  data_assignments = NULL,
  taxon_names = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="list_fold_results">list_fold_results</code></td>
<td>
<p>List of fold results from [run_sjsdm_selected_fold()] or the cached builder.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_assignments">data_assignments</code></td>
<td>
<p>Location-level fold assignment table used to derive expected coverage.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="taxon_names">taxon_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Full ordered response-taxon names.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list with combined predictions and fold diagnostics.
</p>

</main>
